items.idea: Why do Airplanes Leave White Trails in the Sky?
items.notes: Explain why the white trails are left in the sky when airplanes fly in the air.

items.idea: How does Noise Cancellation Actually Work?
items.notes: Explain how noise cancellation works in like in headphones. How does it actually block the noise from outside coming to your ears.

items.idea: Why do You Feel so Lazy?
items.notes: Explain the reason for why humans naturally feel lazy like how our ancient ancestors needed to save calories and physical power for true survival needs or other stuff like heavy mental work. Also list out ways in which a person can force themselves to be less lazy.
